events.title: Bishops of Visigothic Gaul meet at the Council of Agde
events.description: With the permission of the Arian king Alaric II, Catholic bishops met at Agde and issued canons on clerical discipline, marriage and church property. Many entered later collections of church law.
events.html: With the permission of the Arian king Alaric II, Catholic bishops met at Agde and issued canons on clerical discipline, marriage and church property. Many entered later collections of church law.

events.title: John the Fearless is murdered on the bridge at Montereau
events.description: The Duke of Burgundy was killed by followers of the Dauphin Charles during peace talks. Burgundy allied with England, leading to the Treaty of Troyes that made Henry V heir to France.
events.html: The Duke of Burgundy was killed by followers of the Dauphin Charles during peace talks. Burgundy allied with England, leading to the Treaty of Troyes that made Henry V heir to France.

events.title: Oliver Hazard Perry wins the Battle of Lake Erie
events.description: Perry's American squadron captured the entire British force on Lake Erie. His message 'We have met the enemy and they are ours' heralded the recovery of Detroit and the American north-west.
events.html: Perry's American squadron captured the entire British force on Lake Erie. His message 'We have met the enemy and they are ours' heralded the recovery of Detroit and the American north-west.

events.title: Elias Howe patents the lockstitch sewing machine
events.description: Elias Howe received a US patent for a machine using an eye-pointed needle and a shuttle to form a lockstitch. He later won royalties from Singer and other makers who used his design.
events.html: Elias Howe received a US patent for a machine using an eye-pointed needle and a shuttle to form a lockstitch. He later won royalties from Singer and other makers who used his design.

events.title: Canada declares war on Germany
events.description: A week after Britain, Canada's parliament declared war on Germany in its own right. More than a million Canadians served in the Second World War.
events.html: A week after Britain, Canada's parliament declared war on Germany in its own right. More than a million Canadians served in the Second World War.
